description: Use this skill when a deployment, source push, or package version fails because a metadata type is unsupported, partially supported, or behaves differently across Metadata API, source tracking, unlocked packages, and 2GP managed packages. NOT for deployment error troubleshooting, Metadata API tutorials, or dependency mapping — use devops/deployment-error-diagnosis.
inputs: List of metadata types or component names that are failing or suspected to be unsupported
Deployment target context: source deploy, change set, unlocked package, or 2GP managed package
Salesforce API version in use (affects which types are supported)
Org edition and feature licenses that may gate metadata type availability
name: metadata-api-coverage-gaps
official_sources: Metadata API Developer Guide, Metadata Coverage Report and Unsupported Metadata Types (Summer '26 PDF, api_meta.txt L9548–9559) -- the report's channels; unsupported types are changed manually in each org; some types are also unsupported in source tracking, packaging, and change sets. Supports Core Concepts and Gotchas 5, 6, 7.

Metadata API Developer Guide, OrgPreferenceSettings (Winter '27 api_meta.txt L127184-127198; 262: L123747–123762) -- removed in API 48.0, preferences moved to Settings Boolean fields in 47.0. Supports the removed-type example.

Metadata API Developer Guide 264 (Winter '27), ApexSettings `enableEnforceSummer26ApexHeapLimit` (api_meta.txt L113855-113862) -- nonproduction-only, Winter '27-only heap opt-out; Spring '27 enforces the higher limits regardless. Supports the release-bound Settings field example in Gotchas.
Salesforce DX Developer Guide, `sourceApiVersion` (sfdx_dev.txt L2408–2416) and `.forceignore` structure using `.gitignore` rules (L1784–1798). Supports Gotchas 3 and 4.

Metadata API Developer Guide, FlowDefinition (Winter '27 api_meta.txt L76653-76663; 262: L73925–73931) -- the API 44.0 recommendation to stop using FlowDefinition for activation, and that flow definitions in a deploy override the flows' status fields. Supports the active-flow item in SKILL.md.
outputs: Coverage gap assessment listing each affected metadata type with its support status across Metadata API, source tracking, unlocked packages, and 2GP
Release runbook documenting manual post-deployment steps for unsupported types
Workaround recommendations (Tooling API, post-deploy scripts, Setup UI steps, or data loader)
package.xml or sfdx-project.json adjustments to exclude unsupported types and avoid silent failures
